scope: Exact algebraic/rational fixtures for finite-precision conclusions; these are not a test suite or external validation.

conventions.trace_distance: one half of the trace norm
conventions.classical_total_variation: one half of the L1 distance

qubit_spectral_collision.family: rho(g,theta) = 1/2 (I + g(cos(2 theta) sigma_z + sin(2 theta) sigma_x))
qubit_spectral_collision.precision_consequence: For state error epsilon, angular mesh epsilon/g suffices; the one-angle packing needs log2(g/epsilon)-O(1) bits when g>=4 epsilon. At g<=epsilon one reference state suffices.

rank_boundary.identity: T(rho(lambda) tensor n, |0><0| tensor n) = 1-(1-lambda)^n <= n*lambda
rank_boundary.precision_consequence: Any lambda<=epsilon/n is within epsilon of the rank-one boundary in n-copy trace distance; exact rank identification has no uniform finite precision.

later_coordinate_query.means: +/- r*e_i, i in {1,...,d}; query i selected after archive
later_coordinate_query.resource_scope: arbitrary quantum or hybrid pre-query archive; all branch dimensions charged; no assumption of a joint implementation of all query-specific measurements

finite_output_atom.target: any probability law P with a density

poisson_intensity_rounding.qualification: This bounds law perturbation only; it does not provide a finite-n quantum acquisition protocol for unknown intensity.
